resolutions.researcher_notes: Egypt Oil & Gas Newspaper's Sept-2020 'Crude Oil Squad' report tables a 'Ras Shukheir-Suez Gas Trunkline' (From: Ras Shukheir, To: Suez, 245 km, 16 in, 160 mmcf/d) among Egypt's seven active Gulf of Suez/Sinai gas pipelines, confirming Status=operating as of 2020. Single source, medium tier. url_verifier's automated screen fails on this PDF's multi-column table layout (text extraction reorders adjacent-cell digits/words); hand-confirmed via `pdftotext -layout` that 'Trunkline'/'Ras Shukheir' etc. are genuinely present (standing rule 8 -- screen miss, not a verdict).

Same table lists the Ras Shukheir-Suez Gas Trunkline under 'Natural Gas Infrastructure', confirming Fuel = Gas. Single source, medium tier. PDF extraction quirk hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout (see Status unit).

A 245 km / 16-inch line named a 'Gas Trunkline' carrying gas from Ras Shukheir to Suez is definitionally long-haul transmission infrastructure. PipelineType=transmission follows directly from the source's own 'Trunkline' naming and description. Single source, medium tier. PDF extraction quirk as in Status unit.

Table gives the Ras Shukheir-Suez Gas Trunkline a capacity of exactly 160 mmcf/d, matching the sheet's 160.00 MMcf/d. Single source, medium tier. url_verifier's automated screen misses this due to the PDF table's column layout; hand-confirmed present via pdftotext -layout (standing rule 8).
